soak-5.leaksNote: leaks was measured on a separate 12-minute run of the same scenario with the final build (0 leaks, growth +1.0 MB, threads +0, fds +6): the 60-minute run's end-of-run summary crashed on top's 'threads' column ('9/1'); scripts/perf-sample.sh is fixed.
soak-5.note: Scenario on M1b: 5 clusters, one window, the Pods table of wh-perf-01, a follow of the chatter pod (10 lines/s) and, every 5 minutes, a visit to ConfigMaps (2,000 rows), Deployments and Pods. cpuAvgPct is high because a visible log follow re-renders the SwiftUI log screen several times a second (a P1 item); soak budgets are memory growth, leaks, threads and file descriptors. The 60-minute run used a 100 ms log publish; the final build publishes at most 4 times a second (12-minute run: cpuAvgPct 5.3).

terminalScrollbackCost.note: about 5.4 MB per full 5,000-line terminal at 120 columns, below the 12 MB estimate of section 12.3.2

note: M1b: the Mac shell with the shared iOS screens, KubeTable, the log table, the YAML editor and SwiftTerm. Sampler numbers come from scripts/perf-sample.sh on a Profile build against the test cluster (perf contexts, namespace wh-perf with 80 pods: the single-node test cluster cannot schedule 100). Warnings against M1a are expected: M1a was an empty placeholder window.

environment.machine: Apple silicon Mac (not the MacBook Air M1 reference Mac)
environment.power: on power, caffeinate -disu during the soak
